verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's docs claim CUDA-X/CUDA toolkit compatibility and general AI/LLM workflows on the card, and community reports do show people running LLM inference workloads (41k tok/s) on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell units, suggesting frameworks do run. However, a specific hands-on/community comment states these cards are SM120 architecture 'so no tmem/tcgen05 and lack of support in main libraries,' directly contradicting the notion of seamless official framework support via standard build/support matrices. Missing for 10: an explicit official PyTorch/framework support matrix or release notes confirming Blackwell SM120 compatibility, and resolution of the tcgen05/tmem library-support gap raised by users.
